title: Retire obsolete OAuth entry points from learner account settings

spec.problem: The learner /settings/accounts screen still exposes Google OAuth and link-code exchange even though the canonical migration decision retires that OAuth flow; clicking the CTA returns 404.

acceptance.text: Authenticated /settings/accounts keeps session-scoped identity list and unlink behavior but renders no Google OAuth start CTA.
A linkCode query does not call the retired /api/auth/link/exchange endpoint or display obsolete exchange status.
The visible account screen communicates the retired linked-account capability in Vietnamese, English, and Japanese and remains usable at 390x844.
Anonymous access continues to redirect to localized login; identity GET/DELETE contracts remain unchanged.

spec.expected_behavior: Legacy linked identity management works without entry points into retired OAuth routes; localized page copy explains the unavailable new linking flow.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible Google CTA navigates to /api/auth/google/start and returns 404; linkCode triggers retired exchange handler. Existing identity list/unlink works.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the AUDIT-105 screen commit; keep the preceding linked-accounts screen and server identity API unchanged.

classification.rationale: Remove retired OAuth entry points from learner account settings and remove its obsolete frontend lint baseline entry.
